metadata.gate_statistic_note: f_t is a 212-dim per-coordinate interpolation gate. The existing implementation reports only full-vector gate summaries (mean/std/entropy); there is no principled destination- or register-specific gate coordinate. The per-transition scalar used here is the full-vector mean gate (consistent with the existing mean_gate convention), reported alongside min/max. No semantic mapping between gate coordinates and registers is assumed.
metadata.statistical_discipline_note: Transition-level tables are descriptive; transitions within a sequence are dependent. Inference is seed-level (n=5): per-seed metrics, mean +/- SD, paired t-test and Wilcoxon for E vs F on identical seeds/datasets.
metadata.bin_rule: fixed 0.1 grid on full-vector mean gate; sparse bins (< 200) merged deterministically into the less-populated neighbour until all bins >= 200 or 3 bins remain; final edges reported
